title: Field note: Cloudflare blocks Python's default User-Agent
summary: API calls from Python's urllib get HTTP 403 from Cloudflare; the same calls with a browser User-Agent succeed.

title: Field note: Queued is not changed
summary: A submitted order is staged or queued — not applied. Verify the receipt and check the outcome; never claim success from the request alone.

title: Field note: The capability gate
summary: A scope proves authorization MAY exist. It does not prove the agent can execute the action. Check capability, not just permission.
